ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The air flow on the left side of the figure (marked V,t0,H0) first enters the preheater, and after preheating enters the dryer on the right side at t1; the wet material enters from the lower left of the dryer, marked w1,θ1; the product flows out from the lower right, marked G2,w2,θ2; supplemental heat Q supplemental is drawn inside the dryer; the air is discharged from the right side of the dryer, marked t2,H2. It can be seen from the figure that the preheater only raises the temperature before the air enters the dryer, and the dryer body additionally has Q supplemental. Reasoning calculation: Product amount G2=53.5 kg/h, w2=0.05, so the absolutely dry solid flow rate Gs=G2(1-w2)=53.5×0.95=50.825 kg/h. The feed moisture content w1=0.20, therefore the wet feed material amount G1=Gs/(1-w1)=50.825/0.80=63.53125 kg/h. Amount of evaporated water W=G1w1-G2w2=63.53125×0.20-53.5×0.05=12.70625-2.675=10.03125 kg/h. The preheater only raises temperature and does not humidify, therefore the dryer inlet humidity H1=H0=0.01 kg/kg dry gas. The dry air flow rate L=W/(H2-H0)=10.03125/(0.05-0.01)=250.78125 kg dry gas/h. According to the humid-air enthalpy I(t,H)=ca t+H(r0+cv t), take ca≈1.01 kJ/(kg dry gas·℃), cv≈1.88 kJ/(kg water vapor·℃), r0≈2500 kJ/kg: I1=I(120,0.01)≈1.01×120+0.01×(2500+1.88×120)≈148.46 kJ/kg dry gas; I2=I(70,0.05)≈1.01×70+0.05×(2500+1.88×70)≈202.28 kJ/kg dry gas, so L(I2-I1)≈1.3499×10^4 kJ/h. The heat for heating the dry material is GsCps(θ2-θ1)=50.825×1.5×(50-30)=1524.75 kJ/h. The sensible-heat term of the liquid water in the material is cw[(G2w2)θ2-(G1w1)θ1]=4.2×[(2.675×50)-(12.70625×30)]≈-1039.24 kJ/h. Therefore perform an enthalpy balance on the dryer: Q supplemental=L[I2-I1]+GsCps(θ2-θ1)+cw[(G2w2)θ2-(G1w1)θ1]≈13498.8+1524.75-1039.24≈13984.3 kJ/h.

raw_record.question_text: The parameters of a dryer operating at atmospheric pressure are as shown in the figure. Among them: air conditions $t_{0}=20^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $H_{0}=0.01\,\mathrm{kg/kg}$ dry gas, $t_{1}=120^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $t_{2}=70^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $H_{2}=0.05\,\mathrm{kg/kg}$ dry gas; material conditions $\theta_{1}=30^\circ\mathrm{C}$, moisture content $w_{1}=20\%$, $\theta_{2}=50^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $w_{2}=5\%$, specific heat capacity of the absolutely dry material $C_{ps}=1.5\,\mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot^\circ C)}$; the production capacity of the dryer is $53.5\,\mathrm{kg/h}$ (calculated by the product leaving the dryer), the heat loss of the dryer is neglected, the heat that should be supplemented to the dryer $=\_\,\mathrm{kJ/h}$

method.method_draft:
1) 由产品量求干固体流量：Gs=G2(1-w2)，进料湿物料量 G1=Gs/(1-w1)。
2) 蒸发水量 W=G1 w1-G2 w2。因预热器只升温不加湿，干燥器入口湿度 H1=H0，所以干空气流量 L=W/(H2-H0)。
3) 对图中干燥器单独作焓衡算：Q补 = L[I(t2,H2)-I(t1,H0)] + Gs Cps(θ2-θ1) + cw[(G2 w2)θ2-(G1 w1)θ1]。
4) 代入题给数值，并取常用常数 ca≈1.01 kJ/(kg干气·°C), cv≈1.88 kJ/(kg水汽·°C), r0≈2500 kJ/kg, cw≈4.2 kJ/(kg·°C)，即可得到约 13984.3 kJ/h。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 该推理轨迹整体可信：先描述图像结构，再进行物料衡算和焓衡算，符合图像题“先描述图像，再推理”的要求；图中预热器、干燥器、空气进出口、湿物料入口、产品出口及 Q补 标注均与描述一致。计算路线与方法草案一致，最终结果与标准答案 13984.3 kJ/h 一致。唯一小问题是 L(I2-I1) 的中间乘法数值按所列 I1、I2、L 直接计算会有约 0.7 kJ/h 的微小舍入差异，但不影响最终答案，可在修订时统一有效数字或说明为近似值。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: 以干燥器本体为控制体，直接求图中干燥器内 Q补；不把预热器作为能量衡算对象，t0 只用于确认预热器不改变湿度。
planner_metadata.image_role: 先从图读出流程结构：左侧空气 V,t0,H0 先经预热器，变为 t1 后进入干燥器；干燥器右侧排出空气 t2,H2；下方湿物料 w1,θ1 进入，产品 G2,w2,θ2 排出；Q补 是加在干燥器内部的热量。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 使用稳态干燥过程的水分衡算、干基空气湿度定义 H=kg水/kg干气，以及湿空气焓 I=ca t+H(r0+cv t)。物料焓以 0°C 液态水为基准，包含干固体显热和液态水显热；热损失为零。

possible_risk_flags: 湿空气焓常数和中间舍入会造成约1 kJ/h以内的微小差异

method.method_draft:
1) 与物料衡算相同，先求 Gs=G2(1-w2)、G1=Gs/(1-w1)、蒸发水量 W=G1w1-G2w2、干空气流量 L=W/(H2-H0)。
2) 计算三个空气状态的湿空气焓：I0=I(t0,H0)、I1=I(t1,H0)、I2=I(t2,H2)。
3) 对“预热器+干燥器+物料过程”的整体作能量衡算：Q总 = L(I2-I0) + Gs Cps(θ2-θ1) + cw[(G2w2)θ2-(G1w1)θ1]。
4) 对预热器单独求热负荷：Q预 = L(I1-I0)。
5) 因图中所求 Q补 只加在干燥器内，故 Q补=Q总-Q预。代入常用空气/水汽热容和汽化潜热常数，结果约为 13984.3 kJ/h。
